**Hydrogen – Key Properties** | Property | Value / Description | |----------|---------------------| | **Atomic number** | 1 | | **Atomic mass** | 1.008 u (average; dominated by protium) | | **Electron configuration** | 1s¹ | | **Electronegativity (Pauling)** | 2.20 | | **First ionization energy** | 13.598 eV (1312 kJ mol⁻¹) | | **Electron affinity** | –0.754 eV (–72.8 kJ mol⁻¹) | | **Boiling point** | –252.87 °C (20.28 K) | | **Melting point** | –259.16 °C (14.01 K) | | **Density at STP** | 0.08988 g L⁻¹ (≈0.0000899 kg m⁻³) | | **Molecular weight (H₂)** | 2.016 g mol⁻¹ | | **State at room temperature** | Diatomic gas (H₂) | | **Reactivity** | Highly flammable; reacts with oxygen to form water; forms hydrides with many metals; forms acids (e.g., HCl, H₂SO₄) when dissolved in water. | | **Isotopes** | • **Protium** (^1H) – most abundant (≈99.98 %)
